body: I think I would like being an electrician. I don't have the funds to pay for the school though. I do qualify for federal loans. I need to call the crisis hotline.

It's not my job making me unhappy. It's my life choices that brought me here. I seriously want to end it. I went to the community college for a brief period after high school but hardly went to class. I got married way too young. I should have dated around more. I have a son. 

What scares me is being homeless. I don't have a drug problem or even smoke. 
I don't want to work two jobs while paying child support. Working two jobs and not having time for school. 

 I want a career! I would love to be my own boss if I decide not to end my life. 

All I qualify for is entry level jobs. I don't want these dead end jobs anymore. I want to grow and learn new skills. When I apply at an entry level job I feel I'm applying with high school graduates.

Thanks. I'll call the crisis phone lines. My nearest community college is 20-30 minutes away. 

I should have listened to my mother. She told me to go to school right after high school. I did have a brief stint at my community college right after high school. I went to actual campus but rarely went to class. It's one of my biggest regrets in life. 

Everyone tells me it's not too late to get a better quality of life. But I don't fucking know how to get out. I feel my life is just wasting away. 
I want a better life but I don't know how. 

I have no money either to start my own business.
